from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and citation relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper cites")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
